name: CKEditor5 Label Fix
description: Prevents CKEditor 5 from mangling label and anchor nesting.
project_description: CKEditor5 Label Fix is a lightweight CKEditor 5 plugin that restores support for HTML <label> markup and its inline children (a, cite, em, b, strong, span, br) inside rich-text content. CKEditor 5 by default splits or drops label wrappers that span links and cite elements (a regression compared with CKEditor 4), which breaks legacy and accessibility-oriented markup. This module registers label as a schema element via General HTML Support, adds the required tags/attributes to the text format's allowed HTML, and ships a text-format filter that repairs already-split label/anchor/cite patterns on output. It is aimed at sites upgrading from CKEditor 4 that must preserve semantic or WCAG-oriented label structure. Installation requires only Drupal core CKEditor 5; there is no admin settings page. It exposes a hidden faux toolbar button (Label Fix Dummy) that acts as the enable switch on the text format's CKEditor toolbar. Related sibling projects: CKEditor5 Sup Fix, CKEditor5 Table Fix, CKEditor5 Definition List Fix.
